allowed_new_flows.origin: authenticated coordinator via measured NAT source
allowed_new_flows.policy: exact control grants; private credential never forwarded
fixed backend and disposable dummy credential
live attempt, durable one-use scripted broker permits, no upstream forwarding

packet_policy_requirements: Default drop at internal ingress and guard IPv4/IPv6 input, output and forward hooks
Permanent neighbor entries and exact source/destination MAC/IP binding; reject ARP from executor once static neighbors exist
Reject unexpected EtherTypes, VLANs, IPv6, IPv4 fragments and source spoofing at ingress
Do not route: forwarding sysctls disabled and forward chain drop even if sysctls change
Evaluate active-attempt authority before any established broker allowance
Fencing removes broker authority and closes active streams; retain separately granted observation/stop control
No blanket established/related exception; replies limited to the three qualified flow directions
No DHCP, DNS, multicast discovery, metadata, host-management or public-network allowance
Boot with disconnected cables until default-deny policy and services are verified; service failure cannot bypass filtering
independent_controls: Windows supervisor absolute lease and forced executor stop independent of guard/coordinator
Guard deadman fences broker on expired authority or lost control connection
Separate observer receiver/counters and disposable stopped-disk extractor; guard is never extractor
